title: neomammillaria cadereytensis var. quadrispina

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomammillaria cadereytensis var. quadrispina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, that have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities.
